description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andrew Farmer II cleared waivers and reverted back to the 49ers roster.
items.impact: Farmer will be on injured reserve.
items.title: Andrew Farmer II clears waivers, reverts back to 49ers roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: William Bradley-King cleared waivers and reverted back to the 49ers roster.
items.impact: Bradley-King will be on injured reserve.
items.title: William Bradley-King clears waivers, reverts back to 49ers roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Jager Burton did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Burton felt a muscle pull while doing drills. Green Bay will be cautious with him early in training camp.
items.title: Jager Burton misses practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Keisean Nixon did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nixon felt a muscle pull while doing drills. Green Bay will be cautious with him early in training camp.
items.title: Keisean Nixon does not practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andy Dalton took second-team reps with the Eagles on Thursday.
items.impact: Dalton will continue to rotate second-team reps with Tanner McKee throughout training camp as they compete for the backup job.
items.title: Andy Dalton sees second-team reps Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars expect Jack Kiser to return some time during training camp.
items.impact: Kiser will miss an unknown amount of time due to a knee injury.
items.title: Jack Kiser (knee) expected back during training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans signed S Hudson Clark.
items.impact: Clark signed as UDFA with the Raiders last season. He'll compete for a depth role in the Titans secondary.
items.title: Hudson Clark signs with Titans

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Deebo Samuel is signing a 1-year deal worth up to $7 million with the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Samuel is back where it all began for him, returning to San Francisco following the news that Ricky Pearsall may miss a significant amount of the 2026 season. Samuel is coming off a season with 727 receiving yards and five touchdowns, and will add a dynamic aspect to a 49ers offense that added Mike Evans and Christian Kirk in the offseason.
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. signs 1-year deal with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers are signing WR Kaden Prather.
items.impact: Prather won a championship in the UFL with the Lousiville Kings. He will compete for a depth role in the wide receiver room with Green Bay.
items.title: Kaden Prather signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyler Murray took the majority of the first-team reps during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Lewis notes that Murray had an impressive deep pass to wide receiver Dontae Fleming. He'll continue to rotate reps with the first-team with J.J. McCarthy.
items.title: Kyler Murray sees majority of first-team reps Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills hosted WR Dante Pettis for a workout.
items.impact: Pettis appeared in eight games each of the last two seasons with the Saints.
items.title: Dante Pettis works out for Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills hosted WR KhaDarel Hodge for a workout.
items.impact: Hodge spent the past four seasons with the Falcons in a depth role.
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge works out for Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts hosted RB Jermar Jefferson for a workout.
items.impact: Jefferson also worked out for Green Bay earlier this week.
items.title: Jermar Jefferson works out for Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted RB Raheem Blackshear for a workout.
items.impact: Blackshear was one of three running backs to workout for San Francisco with Jordan James sidelined with a rib fracture. He did not appear in a game last season.
items.title: Raheem Blackshear works out for 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted RB Khalil Herbert for a workout.
items.impact: Herbert was one of three running backs to workout for San Francisco with Jordan James sidelined with a rib fracture. He appeared in seven games for the Jets last season.
items.title: Khalil Herbert works out for 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted RB Owen Wright for a workout.
items.impact: Wright was one of three running backs to workout for San Francisco with Jordan James sidelined with a rib fracture. He appeared in three games with the Bucs last season.
items.title: Owen Wright works out for 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans hosted RB Alexander Mattison for a workout.
items.impact: Mattison last appeared in 14 games for the Raiders two seasons ago.
items.title: Alexander Mattison works out for Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans hosted RB Hassan Haskins for a workout.
items.impact: Haskins appeared in 12 games with the Chargers last season.
items.title: Hassan Haskins works out for Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers hosted Jordan Whitehead for a visit.
items.impact: Whitehead was recently cleared to resume playing in the NFL from a neck injury.
items.title: Jordan Whitehead visits Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Calvin Ridley was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Ridley missed one day of practice due to an illness. His role in the Titans wide receiver room remains uncertain.
items.title: Calvin Ridley (illness) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Chris Olave has agreed to a four-year, $132 million extension with the New Orleans Saints, including $90 million guaranteed.
items.impact: Olave had a big 2025 season, and it paid off beautifully for the veteran receiver. He's now locked in for the long haul in a promising situation in New Orleans with a breakout QB in Tyler Shough, and new additions Travis Etienne and Jordyn Tyson.
items.title: Chris Olave agrees to four-year, $132 million extension with Saints

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Chase Claypool worked out with the Indianapolis Colts on Thursday.
items.impact: Claypool is attempting an NFL comeback and has not taken a snap since the 2023 season. The wideout last suited up for the Bears and Dolphins in 12 games, when he played sparingly and managed just eight catches for 77 yards.
items.title: Chase Claypool works out with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers released UDFA rookie DT Parker Peterson.
items.impact: Peterson will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Parker Petersen released by Panthers
